campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:d3db7a15-4413-.title: Account Executive - EMEA
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:d3db7a15-4413-.description: Please note: This role is required to be based in London. The entire team goes into the office 5 days per week and you will be working alongside your peers. As one of our first Account Executive's (AE) in London, you will play a critical role in driving growth for Campfire in EMEA. You will work closely with the GTM team to ramp up in the role. You’ll manage the end-to-end sales cycle—from identifying prospects to closing deals—while leveraging automation and lead-generation tools to scale outreach efforts effectively. Campfire is a hyper-growth company, we are looking for thought leaders that will grow with our team and strive to think beyond the details of what is included below. An ideal candidate will bring ideas to the table and strive to achieve results that go beyond the requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead Generation & Prospecting - Build and manage targeted lead lists, ensuring alignment with our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). - In addition to building your own pipeline, you will also partner with an SDR on our GTM team to drive effective pipeline. - Utilize automation tools to identify, segment, and engage potential customers. - Research and qualify leads in the software industry to create a robust sales pipeline. Outreach & Relationship Building - Execute multi-channel outreach strategies, including personalized emails, calls, and LinkedIn engagement. - Identify key decision-makers and influencers within target accounts. - Nurture leads and build relationships that drive trust and long-term partnerships. - Manage the full sales cycle for select accounts, from discovery to contract negotiations. - Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to tailor messaging and value propositions for prospects. - Provide product demonstrations to potential clients and articulate the value of Agent+. Metrics & Reporting - Track, measure, and report on key sales metrics (e.g., lead-to-meeting and meeting-to-close conversion rates). - Continuously optimize workflows and outreach strategies based on performance data. - Optimized use of CRM software (HubSpot) Ideal Candidate Profile Experience: - 5+ years in a full-stack sales role (AE/SDR/BDR) within the software industry - Bonus: Experience selling mid-market finance software (ERP, spend management, invoicing, etc.) - Bonus: Experience working at an early stage startup or startup with a larger company (new market, etc.) - Proven success in building and maintaining a high-quality sales pipeline Skills & Tools: - Expertise in lead list building and working with automation tools. - Expertise in maintaining email infrastructure for optimized outbound engagement. - Strong research skills to uncover insights about prospects and their businesses. - Proficient in CRM management and reporting. Personal Attributes: - Highly proactive, adaptable, and capable of working in a fast-paced environment. - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. - A growth mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:63.title: Business Development Manager - Electronics Manufacturing
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:63.description: Position Summary The Sales Manager (SM) is responsible for driving business development, cultivating strong customer relationships, and managing a multi-million-dollar book of business. This role combines technical expertise with consultative selling to deliver tailored process solutions for customers across multiple industries. The SM identifies and secures new business opportunities, manage a sales pipeline from prospecting through close, maximizes penetration of existing accounts, and provides expert-level product and application knowledge. Reporting to the CEO, the SM collaborates with internal teams and Production Manager to ensure profitability, customer satisfaction, and long-term growth. This role is well suited to a self-directed, results-driven sales professional with a strong background in manufacturing sales who thrives on generating new business.
responsibilities: Business Development & Sales Growth
Prospect, research, and identify new customer opportunities; plan and execute strategies to integrate leads into the business development plan.
Conduct market research to understand industry trends, competitor activity, and client needs and market conditions.
Maximize penetration of existing accounts by introducing additional products and solutions, including upgrading projects.
Develop and execute a business plan and professional portfolio to track and measure progress toward revenue goals. Prepare accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reports for company leadership.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer needs, and use those insights to maintain business development strategy.
Collaborate with marketing, operations, and product teams to align business development efforts with broader company goals.
Track personal sales activity and results against individual targets.
Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with multiple contacts at each account to preserve and expand business.
Act as a technical consultant, educating customers on product specifications, applications, and process improvements.
Conduct on-site visits when necessary, to understand the needs of the client.
Provide timely responses to customer inquiries, support requests, and service needs.
Negotiate sales, pricing, and terms to reflect customer value while ensuring profitability.
Follow up regularly with clients to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
Reporting & Administrative Duties
Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, including pipeline forecasts and goal updates.
Maintain and update CRM to track customer activity, sales opportunities, and performance metrics.
Submit weekly expense reports, travel plans, and business updates in a timely manner.
Manage travel expenses responsibly, including vendor travel, hotels, and client-related costs.
Communicate effectively with internal teams to align customer requirements with company resources and SOPs.
qualifications: Proven experience in industrial, Distributor and manufacturing sales, process consulting, or technical account management. Electronics Manufacturing sales experience preferred, but not required.
Strong knowledge of industrial process equipment and ability to develop technical expertise.
Demonstrated success in business development, customer relationship management, and revenue growth.
Proficiency in CRM systems, forecasting, and expense management.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced growth oriented environment.
Strong organizational and time management abilities.
Strong prospecting and business development skills, with the ability to independently build a pipeline from the ground up. Existing Book of Business is preferred, but not required.

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:bc21dc59-.title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:bc21dc59-.description: About Gen: Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen. About the Role: As a Principal Business Development Executive - Strategic Partnerships, you will help drive the growth of GenDigital by skillfully prospecting for new strategic business opportunities across the company’s product and service portfolio. We are looking for a proactive, consultant-minded team player who is ready to execute to achieve strategic growth. This position focuses on introducing and developing lasting strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for directly engaging with prospective strategic partners from identifying and qualifying companies for partnership, connecting with decision-makers, introducing the appropriate technology portfolio and presenting a compelling value proposition, candidly exploring commercials and crafting sensible GTM business models, negotiating business terms, monitoring reporting and invoicing, and managing partner satisfaction as well as account growth. Necessarily, you will collaborate with key stakeholders in Product Management, Finance, Legal, and Marketing – both inside GenDigital and within the prospective partner companies. Key Responsibilities: • Maintaining assigned key accounts and providing ongoing client support. • Developing and implementing client relationship management strategies. • Communicating with key clients to monitor client expectations and satisfaction. • Identifying new business leads and contacting prospective key clients to promote products and services. • Establishing efficient communication channels and liaising between key clients and internal departments. • Recommending and implementing improvements to the management of key client relationships. • Handling client queries and finding innovative solutions for complex problems. • Monitoring sales performance metrics and facilitating timely interventions. • Performing recordkeeping, as well as preparing sales forecasts and reports. About you: • Bachelor's degree in business management, marketing, or a related field. • A minimum of 5 years enterprise sales experience with history of driving +$XXM annually • Proficiency in CRM software, such as Salesforce What’s Next: Your CV will be reviewed together by the recruiter and hiring manager to assess the scope of your role, the impact you’ve delivered, and how your experience aligns with the position. If shortlisted, the recruiter will invite you to an initial Zoom conversation to discuss your background, what’s compelling you to Gen, and walk you through the interview process. jobgether-jobgether:lever:31d9463c-ce57-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst III based in the United States. The Business Analyst III will play a pivotal role in delivering advanced technology solutions across complex modernization initiatives. The role focuses on translating business needs into clear, actionable technical and functional requirements. You will work extensively with SaaS and COTS applications, legacy mainframe systems, data migrations, and data warehouse integrations. The position combines requirements analysis, process improvement, system investigation, documentation, and stakeholder engagement. You will collaborate closely with business and technical teams to understand workflows, identify root causes, and shape effective solutions. The role also provides opportunities to support UAT, implementation activities, quality assurance, and project delivery. Success will require strong analytical thinking, communication, adaptability, and the ability to operate independently in a complex environment. Gather, analyze, validate, and document detailed business and technology requirements, including requirements derived through reverse engineering of legacy mainframe systems. Analyze business processes and workflows, identify root causes, and recommend improvements that support successful technology implementation. Investigate workflows and data across legacy regulatory systems and develop comprehensive documentation and technical specifications. Create, update, and maintain functional and design documentation, including diagrams that accurately represent business processes and requirements. Facilitate interactive working sessions with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to define requirements, technical specifications, and solution expectations. Support user acceptance testing by helping business teams develop test scripts, validate system functionality, and prepare for implementation. Conduct research and provide analytical support for special projects, user needs, and evolving technology initiatives. Monitor project deliverables to ensure they meet established standards, methodologies, quality expectations, and timelines. Provide guidance and oversight to other team members when assigned, helping maintain consistency across project activities and deliverables. Identify potential delivery and implementation risks and contribute to mitigation strategies and process improvement initiatives. Support changing project requirements and perform additional responsibilities as needed. Requirements 10+ years of experience with relevant business processes and workflows for software development projects, including preparation, review, and approval of project documentation. 3+ years of experience working with the Texas version of the Risk-Based Data Management System (RBDMS) Oil & Gas regulatory system. 10+ years of experience in requirements elicitation, client management, technical documentation, and requirements review. Extensive experience facilitating interactive sessions with business and cross-functional teams and conducting workflow and root cause analysis. 5+ years of experience analyzing workflow and root-cause issues within legacy systems. Strong problem-solving, analytical, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate effectively through written documentation, presentations, and verbal discussions. Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Adobe tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Acrobat, as well as prototyping and diagramming tools such as Visio, SnagIt, Adobe Illustrator, or Axure. Experience developing design documents, functional specifications, technical requirements, workflow diagrams, and other project documentation. Experience supporting UAT, training, system implementation, and validation activities. Familiarity with mainframe environments, COBOL, SQL, Azure DevOps, data warehouses, data lakes,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4cb10eb9-c936-.title: Backend Developer Level 3
jobgether-jobgether:lever:4cb10eb9-c936-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend Developer Level 3 based in United States. This role is an opportunity to build and operate high-scale backend systems within a modern, cloud-native engineering environment. You will work primarily with Node.js and TypeScript while designing distributed, event-driven services that need to remain reliable under demanding production workloads. The position combines hands-on software development with meaningful ownership of architecture, operational excellence, and technical decision-making. You’ll work extensively with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, messaging systems, APIs, and observability tooling. Strong systems thinking and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments will be essential to your success. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced backend engineer who is ready to take ownership of complex platforms and contribute at a senior technical level. Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript, with a strong focus on clean, maintainable, and reliable code. Design and evolve large-scale distributed systems and microservices supporting business-critical workflows across a broad operational environment. Build cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure, leveraging services such as Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, and Cosmos DB. Develop event-driven services and asynchronous processing pipelines while addressing idempotency, message ordering, retries, dead-letter handling, consumer lag, and other distributed-system concerns. Build and maintain high-performance REST APIs that support customer- and associate-facing applications and integrate effectively with systems owned by other teams. Diagnose production performance and reliability issues using logs, traces, metrics, distributed tracing, and application performance monitoring rather than relying solely on local reproduction. Improve observability, scalability, resilience, capacity management, and operational efficiency across backend systems. Contribute to technical design discussions, architecture reviews, and engineering decisions within established system architectures. Take significant ownership of technical initiatives and help coordinate engineering activities, with opportunities to contribute to standups, Scrum ceremonies, solution architecture, and technical leadership. Partner with Product, UX, Mobile, Frontend, and other engineering teams to develop APIs and services that deliver effective user experiences. Champion automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps practices, production readiness, incident response, and operational excellence. Evaluate emerging technologies and AI-assisted development tools that can improve engineering productivity, software quality, and delivery speed. Requirements 6+ years of professional software engineering experience focused on building and operating backend applications. Strong and recent production experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including asynchronous programming patterns and runtime performance considerations. Proven experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and microservice architectures in production. Hands-on experience developing and operating asynchronous, message-based systems, with practical knowledge of idempotency, out-of-order delivery, retries, dead-letter handling, and consumer lag. Strong experience developing and maintaining RESTful APIs and working with NoSQL databases, including partitioning strategies and consistency tradeoffs. Strong and recent hands-on experience developing and operating production applications on Microsoft Azure. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:5db362b0-82da-.title: Senior Data Communications Administrator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5db362b0-82da-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Communications Administrator based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to provide senior-level technical leadership across complex enterprise network and communications environments. You will help design, implement, maintain, and optimize highly reliable connectivity across distributed LAN, MAN, and WAN infrastructures. The position combines hands-on network administration, advanced troubleshooting, security, monitoring, and modernization initiatives. You will work with technologies spanning routing, switching, wireless, firewalls, content filtering, and network monitoring platforms. A key focus will be maintaining secure, high-performance connectivity across geographically distributed and bandwidth-constrained environments. You will also contribute to technical documentation, incident resolution, infrastructure improvements, and knowledge sharing across technical teams. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced networking professional who thrives in complex environments and takes ownership of critical infrastructure. Provide advanced technical support for network planning, maintenance, implementation, and optimization across enterprise WAN environments. Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network hardware including Cisco ISR, Nexus, Catalyst, ASA, and wireless controller platforms. Maintain the stability, availability, security, and performance of distributed LAN, MAN, and WAN environments. Support connectivity across diverse last-mile technologies, including satellite and other network service solutions. Configure and optimize routing, switching, wireless, firewall, and related network services. Support the deployment, administration, and optimization of network monitoring platforms such as Cisco Prime, Cisco DNA, ACS, ISE, and LiveAction. Maintain and support network security and content-filtering technologies, including Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, Zscaler, and BlueCoat. Provide Tier 3 technical support for escalated incidents and critical connectivity problems across the enterprise. Mentor and provide technical guidance to regional technicians and other network support staff. Create and maintain accurate technical documentation covering network configurations, architecture, procedures, and troubleshooting processes. Contribute to network modernization, optimization, capacity planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. Produce incident resolution reports, performance assessments, security configurations, and recommendations for infrastructure improvements. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related discipline is considered an asset. Proven experience configuring, deploying, administering, and supporting large-scale enterprise network environments. Strong hands-on experience with Cisco networking platforms, including ISR, Nexus, Catalyst, ASA, and wireless technologies. Solid knowledge of enterprise routing, switching, wireless networking, firewalls, WAN connectivity, and network security. Demonstrated experience supporting distributed LAN, MAN, and WAN environments, including geographically dispersed or bandwidth-constrained locations. Experience with network monitoring and management platforms such as Cisco Prime, Cisco DNA, ISE, ACS, and LiveAction. Experience supporting network security and content-filtering solutions such as Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, Zscaler, and BlueCoat. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis capabilities, with the ability to diagnose complex infrastructure issues under pressure. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e98141af-5174-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Lead based in Romania. This role will lead the people side of complex, technology-enabled business transformations, with a strong focus on SAP and large-scale ERP implementations. You will shape change strategies that help organizations transition effectively to new processes, systems, and ways of working. The position combines stakeholder engagement, communications, organizational readiness, training, and adoption measurement. You will work across leadership teams, business stakeholders, project teams, and consulting partners to build alignment and momentum. A key focus will be helping manufacturing organizations navigate transformation while minimizing disruption and maximizing adoption. You will have significant ownership over OCM planning, execution, governance, and continuous monitoring throughout major initiatives. This is an opportunity for an experienced change leader to make a measurable impact across complex, enterprise-wide transformation programs. Develop and implement comprehensive Organizational Change Management strategies aligned with transformation objectives, project timelines, and business outcomes. Conduct stakeholder impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and change impact analyses to identify affected groups, risks, and adoption requirements. Facilitate leadership alignment sessions, stakeholder workshops, and engagement activities across different organizational levels. roadrunnerstudios-roadrunner-studios:lev.description: About Halo Materials Halo Materials is a venture-backed advanced materials company pioneering novel technologies to produce domestic, cost-competitive graphite for advanced energy and manufacturing supply chains. Headquartered in New Mexico, home to world-class national laboratories and a fast-growing deep tech ecosystem, we are building a scalable, lower-emissions process to produce high-performance graphite critical to the batteries that power grid storage, EVs, AI datacenters, drones, and consumer electronics. Our leadership team brings decades of experience building and scaling hard tech companies across energy, mobility, and advanced materials, with backgrounds at Tesla, Cruise, Pajarito Powder, and DOE-funded startups, including multiple ventures that have been successfully acquired. Backed by Roadrunner Venture Studios, Halo combines ambitious research and engineering with the operational support, capital access, and long-term vision needed to grow both the company and the people inside it.

Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
